Opening widths from measured cyan jamb runs; swing directions from arcs, door leaf states unknown.

unresolved: Southeast suite (zoneA + SE workroom) has no door to the corridor as drawn: it connects only via D7 between them and exterior doors D_Rdouble/D_b2; corridor dead-ends at the y752 stub pocket. Verified against crops but unusual - kept as drawn.
W_top, W_Rband, W_Lband are ~4.8m continuous cyan bands; mullion subdivision into multiple windows not separable at this resolution.
Right-hand dimension aggregate labels (4060/1940/5940/3120/4940) not individually re-verified; fine-chain ticks were verified instead.
D4 leaf/arc geometry read as single door; arcs could indicate double-acting leaf. Room roles inferred from furniture only.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

crop_context.note: Edge intervals are matching pixels on the crop border (right/bottom are exclusive box limits, so samples are at right-1/bottom-1). A crop edge is not an object endpoint. The suggested box is only an initial 32px context expansion; inspect further as needed to establish both endpoints and adjoining space boundaries. No continuation is inferred.

result.panel_note: Left is the untouched original crop. Right is an exact color-distance mask: magenta outlines candidate bands; blue marks only actual support at the peak coordinate. Marks are coordinate references, not entities. Right-panel local coordinates correspond to the same original crop after removing its combined-image offset.
result.evidence_note: Support intervals are measured only at each candidate peak. They do not prove a whole band is continuous or identify a wall. Filtered or empty results do not prove an object is absent.
result.display_note: For a returned-image point (rx, ry), first multiply by original_pixels_per_returned_pixel to obtain full combined-image coordinates (fx, fy). On the left, original image coordinates are (box_left + fx, box_top + fy). On the right, subtract mask_panel_combined_pixels[0] from fx before adding box_left. Prefer candidates and support intervals, which already use original-image coordinates.

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
No elevation or other floors supplied: z_floor=0 and ceiling_height=3.0m are explicit assumptions (inherited, unchanged).
Door heights 0-2.1m and window sill/head 0.9-2.4m assumed (standard, not observed in plan; inherited, unchanged).
Wall thickness 240mm per plan labels; interior partitions represented at measured stroke centerlines (inherited, unchanged).
Opening widths from measured cyan jamb runs; swing directions from arcs, door leaf states unknown (inherited, unchanged).
ZoneA seed removed in this revision because the drawn evidence shows no wall between corridor and the former zoneA face; the combined open space keeps the corridor seed and circulation role.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

unresolved: RESOLVED THIS REVISION (was prior unresolved note): the prior draft claimed the SE suite had no corridor door and a dead-end corridor. W_top, W_Rband, W_Lband are ~4.8m continuous cyan bands; mullion subdivision into multiple windows not separable at this resolution (inherited).
Right-hand dimension aggregate labels (4060/1940/5940/3120/4940) not individually re-verified; fine-chain ticks were verified instead (inherited).
D4 leaf/arc geometry read as single door; arcs could indicate double-acting leaf. Room roles inferred from furniture only (inherited).

Whether the open hall alcove (former zoneA) had a intended removable partition cannot be determined from this plan; modelled as drawn (open).
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
